seenline.configuration: convert() from src, no OCR callback (scans and images fail closed)

seenline-verify.configuration: the same with --verify (tesseract eng and pdftoppm compare each page with a text layer); one run per file

seenline-ocr.configuration: the same with --ocr (tesseract eng; pdftoppm for PDF pages without a text layer); one run per file

docling.configuration: standard local layout, table and OCR; page metadata exported

unstructured.configuration: auto strategy for PDFs; ocr_only for images; page metadata exported

marker.configuration: stock PdfConverter, paginated output, no LLM; model weights are fetched by the library at run time

tika.configuration: tika-app 3.3.3 text output (-t); needs a Java runtime

pymupdf4llm.configuration: to_markdown with page chunks; AGPL-3.0, run as an external tool, never bundled

opendataloader.configuration: markdown output, default content-safety filters (it strips hidden text); needs a Java runtime
